fact_check.claim: 2004 Sun feature quotes Jeff Hull of Ithaca Renting Company saying 'most would say' the company is trying to rip off their security deposit
fact_check.note: Misquote. The 'most would say' phrase is about the buildings: most would say Collegetown Plaza, Center and Court are nice places. The deposit remark is a separate 'but there is a feeling that Ithaca Renting Company is trying to rip off' deposits. The article pins the quoted phrase on the deposit claim, so the previous fix was applied wrongly.

fact_check.claim: GOL 7-108 subdivision 1 applies to all dwelling units; subdivision 1-a holds the one-month cap and 14-day return; article says it could not tell whether 1-a reaches an ordinary Collegetown lease and so states no cap or deadline
fact_check.note: The statute is clear. 1-a excludes only rent-controlled units (city rent and rehabilitation law, emergency housing rent control law) and listed senior/care facilities. Cap: 'No deposit or advance shall exceed the amount of one month's rent' (exceptions for seasonal-use and owner-occupied co-op units). 14 days after the tenant vacates: itemized statement and return of the remainder, or the landlord forfeits the right to keep any part. An ordinary Collegetown lease is covered. The hedge is wrong and contradicts the meta line, which promises 14-day rights. The previous fix asked for the coverage to be stated from the full text.

fact_check.claim: City amendment passed April 6, 2022, effective May 31, 2022, requires 120 days' written notice before renewing, showing the unit or signing a new tenant; waiver language on the lease's first page
fact_check.note: Dates, rule and first-page waiver (with tenant initials) confirmed in the Sun column by Mehler, who wrote 'I passed an Amendment to Ithaca City Code Chapter 258-10(A)'. The official text is on ecode360 (https://ecode360.com/27390826 per search result, Ord. No. 2022-02); the article says it could not open it, which the previous fix allowed, though a source was available.

fact_check.note: All four numbers and the ITU are listed.
